versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Kepner-Tregoe thinking skill.
- Supports selective defect diagnosis with IS/IS-NOT difference analysis and option selection using MUST/WANT weighting and adverse consequence comparison.
- Detailed procedures and guardrails for both Problem Analysis and Decision Analysis are provided.
- Includes guidance on when to use or not use the method, and verification steps to avoid misapplication or false conclusions.
- Outputs structured decision artifacts tailored to each analysis type.
